thread:
leo-customer: hey team, starting ~09:03 UTC we're seeing a wave of 429s + 2-4s tail latencies from our dedicated pool riptide-prod. dashboard shows burst_credits=0. Affects rr-large-8q (pinned). examples attached. can you help? https://app.redwood/example/logs/abc123

marie-support: sorry for the hit — i'm pinging infra/oncall now. can you paste the error payload and confirm account id?

leo-customer: account=riptide-acct-11 model=rr-large-8q. error snippet: {"error":"admission_rejected","reason":"burst_credits_exhausted","status":429} we also got a couple 503s.

marie-support: @alex-oncall @jasper-eng @priya-sre assigning. ETA?

jasper-eng: grabbing logs now. i'm seeing repeated admission rejects: `admission=reject reason=burst_credits_exhausted pool=riptide-prod headroom=0.12 available_tokens=0`
Paste of relevant log chunk:
```
[09:02:58] admission: eval request id=zyx reason=burst_credits_exhausted pool=riptide-prod token_cost=120 headroom=0.12 avail=0 -> 429
[09:03:12] proxy: gen latency p95=1.8s p99=3.9s
[09:03:21] autoscaler: want=6 have=4 pending=0 scale_cooldown=120s
[09:04:01] admission: reject pool=riptide-prod token_cost=200 reason=burst_credits_exhausted
```

deploy-bot: Autoscale event: requested +2 GPUs for pool=riptide-prod at 09:05:02 (req id: scale-req-2026035805)

priya-sre: initial triage — looks like a noisy tenant (aurora-ops, cid=324) ramped sustained high-TPS bursts. burst credits drained quickly because prefix-cache hit-rate dropped -> higher token usage per request. autoscaler cooldown (120s) prevented fast enough add.

priya-sre: immediate proposals: 1) throttle aurora-ops to reduce peak TPS 2) temporarily increase pool headroom for riptide-prod 3) trigger prewarm/credit refill if finance ok

alex-oncall: immediate mitigations i will run:
- apply per-tenant qps cap: `redwoodctl tenant throttle set aurora-ops --qps 150`
- bump headroom: `redwoodctl pools update riptide-prod --headroom 0.35`
- route 10% of traffic to hosted fallback for pinned model: `redwoodctl route add-fallback --pool riptide-prod --pct 10 --target hosted-us`
Also requesting manual credit refill via billing-bot.

billing-bot: Manual refill request submitted for acct=riptide-acct-11 amount=emergency-credit. needs approval from @finance-ops (ticket: #7894). ETA on approval ~10-15m.

marie-support: jasper — can you share repro steps so eng can validate once mitigations are applied?

jasper-eng: repro script (k6) we used to reproduce locally quickly:
```
import http from "k6/http";
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rr-large-8q', input:'x'.repeat(800)}), {headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer REDACTED','Content-Type':'application/json'}})
}
```
Run with: `k6 run --vus 500 --duration 1m` or stages ramp to 500 rps in 30s. Observed 429s after ~18s when burst credits hit 0 and p99 latency spikes.

leo-customer: we can run a short repro now if it helps validate your fixes.

priya-sre: follow-up infra notes: autoscaler cooldown is conservative for general pools (120s). For burst-sensitive dedicated pools recommend: cooldown=30s, enable proactive prewarm when utilization > 70% for 3m, and min_headroom=0.25. We'll open a config PR.

jasper-eng: short-term admission tweak i'm going to push to canary: increase replenish_rate and shorten burst_window to make credits less brittle. config snippet:
```
admission:
  burst_window_secs: 60
  replenish_rate: 0.4   # fraction per window
  min_headroom: 0.25
```
Canarying to zone us-west-2 first.

alex-oncall: executing immediate commands now. will monitor metrics (burst_credits, admission rejects, p99 latency). @marie-support please keep customer updated.

marie-support: updated leo-customer — we applied a temporary throttle on the noisy tenant, initiated scale-up, and requested an emergency credit refill. monitoring now; please give us ~10m and report any remaining 429s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo-customer: got it — after ~6m latency dropped to ~700ms and 429s stopped. thanks team :raised_hands: please keep me posted on root cause / follow-ups.

priya-sre: confirmed autoscaler finished scale up -> have=6, want=6 at 09:09:40. credit refill approved by finance-ops (txn 0xFA12) — billing-bot confirmed.

marie-support: recording follow-ups & owners:
- headroom policy for dedicated pools (owner: priya-sre)
- autoscaler cooldown tuning + tests (owner: jasper-eng)
- per-tenant short-term qps guardrails + dashboard (owner: alex-oncall)
- runbook entry: emergency credit refill + steps + contacts (owner: marie-support)
Action ETA: end of week for config PRs, runbook by tomorrow.

jasper-eng: i'll open autoscaler PR with tests that simulate noisy-tenant bursts and validate cooldown=30s behavior. will also include unit test for admission replenish math.

priya-sre: i'll update runbook with exact `redwoodctl` commands and add prewarm recipe.

marie-support: closing notes: customer confirmed recovery. we'll follow up with a short postmortem and share actionable changes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

leo-customer: thanks all, appreciate the fast response.
